title: Ory's early radio band, Zutty and Ory's temper
summary: Hall recalls Ory's band working for Standard Oil, trouble between Ory and Zutty, and Ory's temper.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Yeah. When Ory first got his band together working for those radio arson wells, you know, they had Zutty. Yeah, that's right. You were in the factory then.
I was in the factory, and I couldn't get out there. I wondered why you were working with Ory. No, when I picked up that, when he was working for the Standard Oil Company.
That's where I got to know.

That's when I got to see Zutty. After he hired Zutty, well, they had quite a little trouble with Zutty and all. He was an all right fellow, but just see Ory was a peculiar fellow by the time. He used to rush the temper.

He was a good drummer, but that was his biggest fault. And he's always had a squad with the piano players all the time. He wanted to play like he, his temper. So that's why him and Ory practically fell out. It wasn't his playing, it just, that was his trouble. So that's, I got back in the pits again, and I've been with Ory since then, Z.
